about: A free, self-hosted news reader that collects articles from RSS and Atom feeds.

prs.title: Restoring a backup keeps titles readable
prs.broken: Restoring a FreshRSS export encoded article titles and authors twice, so a title with an ampersand showed the raw code, and each restore added another layer.
prs.changed: Titles and authors are decoded before they are encoded again on import.
prs.matters: Moving or restoring a FreshRSS install keeps every article title as it was.
